baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَسِيرُوا فِي الْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا ... عَاقِبَةُ ... وَآثَارًا فِي الْأَرْضِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Bodily traversal exposes a material record; directed seeing converts surviving marks into an inference about the terminal condition of their makers.

activation_trace.role: The branch image of motion and passage supplies the bodily traverse that exposes the landscape.
The lower ground opposite the sky supplies both the field crossed and the substrate bearing remains.
Directing sight or insight to grasp a thing turns seeing into deliberate historical inference.
The last part and outcome of a thing supplies the terminal condition reconstructed from the marks.
A remaining sign that indicates what once existed supplies the landscape's visible evidence.
Sufficiency, benefit, and standing in another's place supply the failed function tested by the ruins.

changed_reading.before: The ayah generally advises travel and reflection on destroyed peoples.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages field investigation: movement reaches the record, disciplined sight reads marks backward, and the makers' terminal condition proves that their resources performed no saving function.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَآثَارًا ... مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Number, concentrated force, public remains, and continuing acquisition form a cumulative power portfolio; the sufficiency clause audits the portfolio as a whole and finds it non-convertible into safety.

activation_trace.role: Numerical rivalry and predominance make greater population a claimed form of competitive power.
The branch image of force and solidity supplies the intensified durability claimed for the former peoples.
Strength gathered like the strands of a rope supplies an image of coordinated capacities, means, and supporters.
Surviving marks make accumulated power externally measurable after its owners are gone.
Seeking and obtaining livelihood or benefit supplies the portfolio's active process of accumulation.
The ability to suffice or substitute for another supplies the audit criterion that every accumulated asset fails.

changed_reading.before: The former peoples simply had more people and material strength.
changed_reading.after: The comparison inventories mutually reinforcing assets, then denies the crucial conversion: no quantity of demographic, coercive, monumental, or acquired capital becomes protection.

baseline_models.mechanism: The observer moves forward geographically while reasoning backward temporally: a predecessor's track is followed from remaining sign to rearward source and finally to outcome.

activation_trace.role: Physical forward passage supplies the observer's direction through the present landscape.
Going upon the trace of a predecessor turns the surviving mark into a track that can be followed.
The rear foot and its trace supply the backward-facing geometry of inference from footprint to absent maker.
What precedes or comes before supplies the temporal destination reached by following the track.
Directed visual and intellectual attention performs the reversal from present trace to prior history.

changed_reading.before: Travel and looking are two adjacent exhortations.
changed_reading.after: Travel and looking form one reverse-tracking operation: the body advances across the earth while thought follows the predecessor's footprint backward to its end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim earlier version of the focus identifies the unspecified historical failure as culpable seizure and the absence of any protective barrier; the next ayah explicitly names punitive consequence.

activation_trace.role: Failed sufficiency anchors the later version's question about what the accumulated resources could actually do.
Acquired benefit supplies the later version's broad class of resources whose saving performance is denied.
The same outcome branch marks the repeated scaffold as an explicit internal parallel to the focus.
Being taken to account for an offense supplies the causal force hidden behind the visible terminal condition.
Sin or culpability supplies the stated ground for seizure rather than an impersonal cycle of decline.
Repelling harm by a protective covering specifies the saving function that former power failed to provide.
Punishment following offense sharpens the focus's outcome from bare collapse into a consequential sequel.

structural_cues: 40:21 repeats the focus's travel-look-outcome and stronger-force-traces scaffold almost word for word.
40:21-22 replace the focus's earnings ending with seizure for sins, no protector, and severe punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact internal parallel and its explicit ending; I carry that ending into the focus as a causal gloss. The live alternative is that the focus deliberately broadens beyond protection and culpability to every kind of acquired advantage.

changed_reading.before: The former peoples' resources failed during an unspecified historical collapse.
changed_reading.after: Their acquisitions failed specifically to become a shield against being taken for culpability; the visible outcome is the terminal face of an accountable sequel.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's earlier judgment formula places the same earning root under exact recompense, expanding the focus's acquisitions from material proceeds to morally attributable acts.

activation_trace.role: Obtaining benefit anchors the focus's open-ended object: whatever they kept acquiring.
Sufficiency supplies the failed attempt to make earned proceeds answer for their earners.
The same acquisition image occurs as what each soul is recompensed for, assigning earning moral ownership.
Answering an act with its due counterpart converts accumulation into a ledger that returns upon its agent.

structural_cues: 40:17 places بِمَا كَسَبَتْ in a universal judgment clause.
The focus leaves the object of يَكْسِبُونَ unstated, allowing the surah's earlier moral use to remain active.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical repetition and the recompense construction; I infer that the focus's imperfect verb gathers accountable practice as well as wealth. A strictly economic reading remains possible but no longer exhaustive.

changed_reading.before: What they earned denotes wealth, production, or practical gains.
changed_reading.after: What they earned is also their accrued agency: deeds enter a recompense ledger and therefore cannot serve as an external asset that substitutes for the earner.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening warning treats prosperous circulation through lands as a glittering but unstable surface; the focus counters that deceptive mobility by requiring observers to read movement from its outcome.

activation_trace.role: Passage through the earth anchors mobility as the phenomenon that must be interpreted.
Directed perception supplies the corrective discipline applied to the surface appearance of circulation.
The end of the matter supplies the retrospective criterion by which mobility is judged.
Deception by what gleams but does not endure makes visible circulation an unreliable sign of security.
Turning about and moving toward a destination supplies the restless circulation whose success can mislead.
Bounded places of the earth supply the territorial network across which apparent success circulates.

structural_cues: 40:4 warns against being deceived by their turning about in the lands.
The focus repeats earth-travel but commands النظر toward عاقبة rather than admiration of current mobility.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two kinds of movement through terrestrial space; I treat the focus as the prescribed antidote to the earlier deceptive surface. The alternative is that 40:4 concerns present commerce while 40:82 concerns literal archaeological travel without a direct contrast.

changed_reading.before: Travel is merely the observer's route to historical examples.
changed_reading.after: Travel also corrects a false metric: circulation across many lands can look like success, but outcome-oriented sight reads beneath that mobile surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Pharaoh sequence gives the focus's آثار a concrete political form: visible sovereignty builds a high structure to project its own epistemology, beautifies the project as work, and ends in loss rather than aid.

activation_trace.role: A durable sign of what once existed anchors monumental remains as evidence of a vanished regime.
Gathered capacities and supports supply the institutional force able to produce large public works.
Failed sufficiency asks whether sovereignty and its structures can perform as rescuers.
Royal dominion supplies the political concentration behind visible power in the earth.
Aid that makes one prevail supplies the explicit question whether terrestrial rule can protect its holders.
Building by joining parts supplies the organized production of a regime's material trace.
The high edifice supplies a specific monumental candidate for the focus's آثار in the earth.
Making something appear beautiful explains how harmful public work gains persuasive surface value.
Purposive work connects constructed أثر to the broader class of what a regime actively produces.
Loss and destruction supply the terminal reversal of the apparently ascending project.

structural_cues: 40:29 joins present sovereignty, ascendancy in the earth, and the question of who can give aid.
40:36-37 narrate a commanded high construction, its epistemic purpose, the beautification of the work, and the plan's ruin.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the political and architectural sequence; I identify the tower as a concrete instance of آثار and its work as one instance of acquisition. آثار can still include settlements, deeds, and every other surviving mark.

changed_reading.before: The آثار are generic ruins demonstrating that large civilizations vanished.
changed_reading.after: The آثار are also monumentalized claims to rule and knowledge: infrastructure makes power visible, yet neither the institution nor its persuasive built surface can act as protector.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence supplies mounts, benefits, ships, and carriage, then says signs are actively shown; the focus converts those granted means of movement into a responsibility to inspect rather than deny.

activation_trace.role: Motion through the earth anchors the use to which the preceding transport capacities can be put.
Directed sight and thought supply the cognitive destination of enabled travel.
Ultimate sufficiency distinguishes ordinary useful carriage from a means able to avert consequence.
Riding on a mount supplies an embodied terrestrial means for the focus's journey.
Benefit as the opposite of harm marks transport as genuinely useful without making it ultimately sufficient.
The ship moving through water extends the available field of travel beyond land routes.
A carrying vehicle supplies the enabling function shared by mount and ship.
Causing something to be seen supplies active disclosure immediately before the commanded looking.
A manifest sign supplies the class of evidence to which visible historical traces belong.
The opposite of recognition supplies denial as the failed response that purposeful looking must correct.

structural_cues: 40:79-80 enumerate riding, benefits, ships, and being carried.
40:81 states that signs are shown and asks which are denied; 40:82 immediately commands travel and النظر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the adjacent provision-disclosure-travel sequence; I infer that transport is granted partly as an affordance for recognition. The live alternative is that 40:79-80 list general benefits and the focus's travel remains only rhetorical.

changed_reading.before: The audience lacks direct access to the old peoples and is told abstractly to travel.
changed_reading.after: The audience has already been carried and equipped: ordinary benefits become instruments of inquiry, so the failure is misuse of available mobility and signs, not absence of access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence contrasts timely interpretive looking with self-satisfied knowledge, then with compelled sight after consequence arrives; benefit fails because recognition occurs only when it can no longer redirect action.

activation_trace.role: Intentional seeing and consideration anchor the timely epistemic act demanded by the focus.
Acquired benefit anchors the possibility that a possessed knowledge portfolio is among what they accumulated.
Failed benefit supplies the temporal test: recognition must arrive soon enough to do saving work.
Active showing establishes that the evidence is presented before the demanded act of النظر.
Nonrecognition names the resistant response to evidence already made visible.
Exultant pride supplies the affective closure produced by confidence in possessed knowledge.
What is disclosed to a knower supplies the rival epistemic capital in which the recipients rejoice.
The descent and enclosure of harm turns what was mocked into an inescapable surrounding reality.
Direct sight of might supplies recognition forced by arrival rather than achieved through prior reflection.
Benefit opposed to harm is explicitly denied to belief that begins only after compelled sight.

structural_cues: 40:81-82 move from signs being shown, through denial, to a command to look at historical outcome.
40:83 contrasts clear proofs with joy in possessed knowledge.
40:84-85 move from seeing punishment to profession of belief and explicit nonbenefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered disclosure-denial-pride-sight-nonbenefit sequence; I infer that possessed knowledge belongs functionally among the focus's gains and that timing controls whether sight can benefit. Material and political earnings remain live alongside this epistemic reading.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts ancient material accomplishment with later ruin.
changed_reading.after: The focus is also the hinge of an epistemic chronology: reflective sight must read traces before coercive sight arrives, while self-sufficient knowledge is itself an acquisition that fails its owners.

context_deltas.mechanism: Inherited writing, reminder, narrated messengers, and physical traces form two media of one historical archive; travel reads the terrestrial record while transmitted narrative reads the verbal record.

activation_trace.role: A report transmitted until it becomes received tradition supplies the verbal half of the archive.
A remaining sign indicating what was supplies the material half of the archive.
Visual and intellectual examination supplies the common reading operation across both media.
The inheritance of knowledge or a book supplies transmission from prior community to later reader.
Ordered letters and the written object supply the archive's stable textual medium.
A reminder that restores what might be forgotten supplies the archive's intended cognitive effect.
Following a trace supplies the shared logic linking narration with the focus's terrestrial investigation.
Leading a report in sequence supplies narrated history as a second route through predecessors' outcomes.

structural_cues: 40:53-54 call the inherited book guidance and reminder.
40:78 distinguishes messengers narrated from those not narrated shortly before the focus turns to travel and آثار.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inherited text, narrative selection, and the focus's visible traces; I join them as complementary evidence systems. The alternative is to reserve آثار here for physical remains and keep narration only as surrounding support.

changed_reading.before: The traveler consults ruins while the reader separately receives stories.
changed_reading.after: The ayah asks for cross-media historical reading: narrated reports follow verbal traces, and travel follows material traces, with each medium testing the other's account of power.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic creation relativizes human magnitude, while the life-stage sequence makes fullest strength a temporary phase; the former peoples' comparative superiority is real but enclosed within creaturely scale and time.

activation_trace.role: Growth in number anchors the former peoples' real comparative magnitude.
Force and solidity anchor the real intensity of their mature power.
Gathered strength supplies the capacity whose apparent durability is being rescaled.
Bringing creation into existence supplies a scale on which even great human production is derivative and small.
Magnitude as the opposite of smallness explicitly places cosmic creation above human creation.
The same numerical abundance branch shifts from a boast about peoples to the many who fail to know the larger scale.
Attaining full strength supplies maturity as one bounded stage between infancy and old age or death.

structural_cues: 40:57 says creation of heavens and earth is greater than creation of people and links failure to the majority's lack of knowledge.
40:67 places بلوغ الأشد inside a sequence from dust and embryo through old age and death.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic comparison and the lifecycle of full strength; I use both to rescale the focus's human comparison. The alternative is that the focus only argues a fortiori within political history, without invoking creaturely temporality.

changed_reading.before: The ayah defeats the audience by citing an even stronger human civilization.
changed_reading.after: It grants the human comparison but dissolves its absolutism: numerical greatness is tiny against creation, and peak strength is only a passing creaturely stage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same sufficiency root appears in the followers' request that their former leaders take a share of harm for them; this turns failed availing into a collapse of patronage and delegated protection.

activation_trace.role: Sufficing, benefiting, or standing in another's place anchors the focus's denied protective substitution.
Acquired benefits include the social capital and hierarchy accumulated around powerful actors.
The followers ask whether the powerful can suffice for them by absorbing a share, exposing the desired substitution directly.

structural_cues: 40:47 places مُغْنُونَ in a dialogue between followers and those who were arrogant.
The requested function is explicitly relational: leaders are asked to take a share on behalf of dependents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and a concrete failed patronage relation; I extend the focus's gains to networks of followers, elites, and protection. The alternative is that 40:47 exemplifies only one narrow case of the focus's general nonbenefit.

changed_reading.before: Possessions cannot save their individual owners.
changed_reading.after: Accumulated hierarchy cannot save dependents either: power fails precisely where patronage promised that one person or class could answer in another's place.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus root's branch of conduct or course is activated by the closing declaration of a running way through departed generations; travel becomes participation in, and recognition of, a recurrent historical procedure.

activation_trace.role: A sira as course, manner, or state allows the command to resonate beyond locomotion as attending to historical conduct.
Succession and alternation supply the repeated passage from one generation to the next.
A running path and followed practice supplies the explicit recurring course that frames historical outcomes.
The passing of time and departure of a generation supplies the recurrent occupants of that course.
Explicit nonbenefit after late sight supplies the stable terminal rule of the recurring course.

structural_cues: 40:85 names a سنة that has passed among servants.
The closing recurrence of sight, nonbenefit, passing generations, and loss retrospectively frames the focus's travel-outcome sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a lexical branch for sira and an explicit final sunna; I allow them to resonate as course and recurring way without replacing the ordinary sense of physical travel. The physical command remains primary.

changed_reading.before: They are asked only whether they have moved through geographical space.
changed_reading.after: The movement also shadows a question about course: have they entered the recurrent path deeply enough to recognize the procedure that carried prior generations from confident gain to nonbenefit?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's non-dominant ث و ر mapping for ء ث ر and is therefore a branch-distant material activation, not a claim that آثار is lexically disambiguated as excavation. It remains anchored in the focus's آثار immediately followed by في الأرض and may be rendered only as a secondary image of land visibly disturbed by human power.

activation_trace.role: Stirring and moving earth from its place supplies an image of large-scale alteration embedded in the form of the land.
The terrestrial surface supplies the material directly altered and later inspected.
Directed perception turns modified terrain itself into evidence rather than looking only for freestanding ruins.

changed_reading.before: آثار are objects left upon the earth.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, آثار can include what power did to the earth itself: cuts, raised works, disturbed ground, and other terrain-scale signatures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The termite branch of ء ر ض is remote from the ordinary noun الأرض, so this must not be presented as the verse's lexical meaning. It remains focus-anchored because الأرض occurs twice around enduring آثار and usefully reverses monumentality: the ground bearing a trace also contains an image of matter quietly consuming built material.

activation_trace.role: The wood-eating creature supplies a contained image of terrestrial matter internally consuming what appears durable.
The surviving mark supplies the monumental remainder whose durability is being questioned.
Failed sufficiency turns material persistence itself into an inadequate substitute for living security.

changed_reading.before: The earth passively preserves impressive remains.
changed_reading.after: In a deliberately qualified material image, the same earth that displays power also consumes it from within; even the archive of monuments is perishable and cannot suffice.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is an imagistic reversal across branch inventories, not a syntactic gloss on أَشَدَّ قُوَّةً. It remains valid because the focus itself supplies strength as gathered rope-like capacities, while 40:71 supplies connected rings and a binding collar; downstream prose should mark the reversal as suggestive rather than determinative.

activation_trace.role: Tightening a knot or bond supplies power as something fastened and consolidated.
Strength gathered like rope strands supplies the braided structure of collective capacity.
A collar that binds a limb supplies the reversal of consolidated power into imposed restraint.
Connected rings and parts supply the chain-form that mirrors gathered strength while reversing its agency.

changed_reading.before: Greater strength is a larger quantity of free capacity.
changed_reading.after: As a contained reversal, tightly gathered capacities resemble the very connected bonds into which domination can turn: what was consolidated as power returns as consolidation under restraint.

strongest_changes: The exact 40:21-22 echo identifies failed sufficiency as failure to become a shield against culpable seizure and punitive outcome.
40:17 moves كسب into a recompense ledger, so the focus's gains include accountable deeds rather than material proceeds alone.
40:29 and 40:36-37 concretize آثار as monumentalized rule whose visible construction and epistemic project cannot provide aid.
40:79-81 make transport and displayed signs immediate affordances for the focus's travel and looking.
40:83-85 turn the focus into a timing test between reflective sight, pride in possessed knowledge, compelled sight, and belief that no longer benefits.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet makes 40:82 a convergence point rather than a generic ruins maxim: it repeats an earlier seizure formula, reuses earning from judgment, converts Pharaoh's tower into a candidate أثر, places travel directly after granted transport and shown signs, and immediately precedes the collapse of self-satisfied knowledge into late sight.
remaining_uncertainties: The scope of مَا كَانُوا يَكْسِبُونَ remains deliberately open between wealth, deeds, institutions, knowledge, and social capital.
The archive model may overjoin narrated reports and material آثار even though the packet activates both branches.
The sira-sunna resonance and all three outliers should remain explicitly exploratory rather than replace the ordinary morphology and syntax.
